policy.new_root_namespace: AgenToolsPlatform\ is not registered as a package-wide prefix; each non-overlapping child prefix has exactly one owner.
policy.new_package_distribution: Private local/path or owner-controlled private artifacts only; manifests/locks/no-dev checks must be created by owning tasks. No registry upload or public name availability claim.
policy.action_handler_policy: One code-only ActionDefinition registry projects execution/model/admin views. DB configuration never loads PHP classes, SQL/URLs or tools. Mandatory guards cannot be removed by plugins/raw/fakes.
policy.target_lock_gate: Unknown/missing/corrupt required evidence is non-green; absent planned source does not prove purity. No new package installed or dependency resolved in this ADR.

dated_contract_bridge.actions: Dated Action wire/ports remain owned by agentools/sdk; bridge translates only declared additive values, not statuses or guards. Core declares a narrow orchestration port and does not fork the dated EventStore/reducer/token protocol.
dated_contract_bridge.llm: Existing PHP/Dart LlmPort.respond and ScenarioRunner remain native entrypoints. PHP compatibility adapter stays separate from the proposal-only transport; Dart sync API is not replaced by an implicit Future.
dated_contract_bridge.identity: Keep both ScenarioRunner key derivations and persisted identity on retry. No old/new loop executes one turn. Durable proposal mapping reuses saved ConfirmationService result instead of regenerating prepare identity.
dated_contract_bridge.durability: EffectCommitter local append is insufficient. Future dispatcher proves committed storage/fence/guards before calling an effect owner.

planned_path_resolution.authority: Current root.architecture + explicit P1.4 direct-driver instruction and accepted P1.2 C supersede the historical planned directory label; no API/namespace migration or plan-source edit.

limitations: All new packages/autoload mappings/ports are selected design, not created runtime.
